name: boxhead
description: BoxHead: a co-op zombie extraction shooter. Rust game server and ops dashboard, TypeScript/Vite client.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && cargo build && cd ../dashboard && cargo build && cd .. && node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/e2e/server.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
